description: This file defines thread helper classes and functions for testing thread synchronization in the starboard namespace, including a TestSemaphore class, thread entry points, and an abstract thread wrapper.

classes.name: TestSemaphore
classes.description: A semaphore class for thread synchronization with methods to put, take, and try to take permits.

classes.name: WaiterContext
classes.description: A struct managing synchronization primitives for waiting and signaling in tests.

classes.name: TakeThenSignalContext
classes.description: An aggregate struct used with thread entry points for signaling and delays.

classes.name: AbstractTestThread
classes.description: An abstract base class for creating threads in tests, requiring subclasses to override Run().

methods.name: TestSemaphore()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing permits to zero.

methods.name: TestSemaphore(int initial_thread_permits)
methods.description: Constructor initializing permits to a specified value.

methods.name: Put()
methods.description: Increases the semaphore permits and signals waiting threads.

methods.name: Take()
methods.description: Blocks until a permit is available, then decrements permits.

methods.name: TakeTry()
methods.description: Attempts to take a permit without blocking; returns true if successful.

methods.name: AddOneEntryPoint(void* context)
methods.description: Adds one to the input value, used as a thread entry point.

methods.name: WaiterEntryPoint(void* context)
methods.description: Thread entry point that signals and waits on condition variables.

methods.name: TakeThenSignalEntryPoint(void* context)
methods.description: Signals a semaphore and then signals a condition variable.

methods.name: Wait()
methods.description: Waits on condition variable, increments waiters count, signals.

methods.name: WaitForReturnSignal()
methods.description: Waits until unreturned_waiters > 0, then takes one.

methods.name: Run()
methods.description: Pure virtual method to be overridden by subclasses to define thread behavior.
